info.name: QAssure Identity & Platform Service
info.description:
Complete API collection — 93 endpoints across 13 groups.

**SETUP:**
1. Import this collection + companion environment file
2. Set `base_url` in environment (default: http://localhost:3000)
3. Run 'Login (captures tokens)' first — auto-captures access_token, refresh_token, tenant_id
4. All subsequent requests inherit Bearer token automatically

**SSO FLOW (3-step test):**
1. Run 'Launch Module (SSO Token)' — auto-extracts launch_token from launch_url
2. Set `api_key` variable to the target module's API key
3. Run 'Verify Launch Token' — returns full user context + session JWT

**AUTO-CAPTURED VARIABLES:**
Login → access_token, refresh_token, tenant_id, user_id
Create User → user_id | Create Role → role_id
Create Dept → department_id | Create Desig → designation_id
Create Category → user_category_id | Register Module → module_id
Launch Module → launch_token (from launch_url)
Create Review → review_id | Get Review Items → review_item_id

Generated: March 2026 | Source: verified codebase + live DB schema

item.name: 12 · Modules & SSO Launch

request.description:
Auth: X-API-Key header (module's API key). NO JWT.

Request body field: "token" (NOT "launch_token")
Token format: starts with 'mlt_', min length prefix + 64 hex chars

Validation checks:
1. Format: starts with 'mlt_'
2. Hash lookup: SHA-256 of token → module_launch_tokens.token_hash
3. Expiry: expires_at > NOW() (60-second window)
4. Single-use: used_at must be NULL
5. Module match: API key's moduleId must match token's module_id

On success: marks token used (used_at, used_by_ip, verification_module_api_key_id)
Fetches LIVE data from DB (user dept/desig/category, permissions, tenant logo)
Generates NEW session JWT via jwtService.generateAccessToken()

Response field is 'token' NOT 'access_token'.
Admin flags in 'access' object NOT 'user' object.

JWT. Returns modules current user can access.
Super admin: pass ?tenant_id query param.
authorize(tenants, read). Modules available for role assignment.

request.description:
JWT auth. Generates one-time SSO launch token.

Super admin: pass ?tenant_id query param.

ACCESS CONTROL (from canUserLaunchModule):
- Super Admin: always allowed if tenant_id provided + tenant exists and active
- Tenant Admin: all modules assigned to their tenant (via tenant_modules)
- Regular User: must have user_roles entry with module_id OR role in role_modules

RESPONSE (from generateLaunchToken line ~220):
{
  success: true,
  data: {
    launch_url: '<base_url>/auth/sso?token=mlt_<64-hex>',
    expires_in: 60,
    module: { id, module_id, name },
    tenant: { id, name }
  }
}

Token is ONLY in launch_url. No separate 'launch_token' field.
Test script auto-extracts the token from the URL.

item.description:
Base: /api/v1/modules
Source: module_routes.js + module.controller.js + module_launch.service.js

═══ SSO LAUNCH FLOW (verified from module_launch.service.js) ═══

Step 1 → POST /modules/:id/launch (JWT auth)
  Response: { success, data: { launch_url, expires_in: 60, module: {id,module_id,name}, tenant: {id,name} } }
  Token is embedded in launch_url: <base_url>/auth/sso?token=mlt_<64-hex-chars>
  NO separate 'launch_token' field. TTL = 60 seconds.

Step 2 → Browser redirects to launch_url

Step 3 → POST /modules/verify-launch-token (X-API-Key auth)
  Body: { "token": "mlt_..." }  ← field name is 'token' NOT 'launch_token'
  Response: { success, data: {
    user: { id, email, first_name, last_name, mobile,
            department_id, department_name, department_code,
            designation_id, designation_name, designation_code,
            user_category_id, user_category_name },
    tenant: { id, name, slug, company_name, company_logo },
    access: { is_super_admin, is_tenant_admin },
    permissions: ['resource:action', ...],
    module: { id, module_id, name },
    token: '<session-jwt>',  ← NOT 'access_token'
    expires_in: <seconds>,
    expires_at: '<ISO-8601>',
    launched_at: '<ISO-8601>'
  }}
